thought: Okay, I will create the project requirements for a chat application with a vibrant frontend that allows two users to chat using WebSockets. I will also decide on additional features. I will start by creating a project plan, defining the directory structure, and then generating the code for both the frontend and backend.
title: Vibrant Chat Application

steps.title: Create Project Directory Structure
steps.description: Create the directory structure for the VibrantChat application. This includes creating directories for the backend and frontend, as well as subdirectories for components, styles, utils, services, controllers, routes, data, and tests.
steps.note: This step ensures that the project has a well-organized structure for easier development and maintenance.
